title: Residue constructibility and bounded etale origin for embedded coefficients
statement: For prime ell, finite intermediate E in PadicAlgCl ell, a generator pi of its maximal ideal, Noetherian X and any complex K over the continuous integral coefficient ring, the first constant reduction of restriction K has constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude (residueConstructible of [def-sfb-embedded-integral-model-coefficients]) if and only if the first completed reduction has bounded constructible etale origin under the specified intrinsic realization (integralModelResidueEtaleOrigin of the same node). This includes finiteness and discreteness of the actual residue ring and imposes no boundedness on K.

source.place: First paragraph, finite residue field and clause (2); Stacks Tags 03ET, 06YQ and 09C1.

proof.text: The uniformizer equation identifies the first quotient with the finite residue field. The integer ring is compact and its maximal ideal is open, so the actual quotient topology is discrete. Equip the quotient with its field structure. Apply firstReductionComparison to identify the finite realization of the first constant reduction with the realized first continuous reduction.

Apply finiteFieldCohomologyCriterion to the first constant reduction B. It identifies constructible homology and finite Tor amplitude with intrinsically constructible bounded homology of finiteRealization B.

The essential-image clause of finiteRing_constructibleDerived_origin identifies this last condition with bounded constructible etale origin. Essential images are closed under isomorphisms; transport the witness across firstReductionComparison and package the finite and discrete instances. Reverse these steps for the converse.

theorem integralModelsEmbeddedResidueComparison
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    ∀ K : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        (integralCoefficientObject X ℓ E)),
      IntegralModelsEmbedded.residueConstructible ℓ E π X
        ((IntegralModelsEmbedded.restriction ℓ E X).obj K) ↔
      integralModelResidueEtaleOrigin X ℓ E π K
